summary: Ares Capital Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose the amendment and restatement of its senior secured credit facility. The changes include an increase in total commitments from ~$5.312B to ~$5.481B, an adjustment to the base interest rate from Term SOFR plus a 0.10% credit spread adjustment to Term SOFR alone, and extensions of the revolving period and stated maturity for most lenders to 2030-2031. This is a routine refinancing and credit facility amendment, not a special situation. The filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, spin-off, or any other special-situations category. It is a standard credit facility amendment for a business development company, reporting entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation.
